note: pinr-recorder-for-line: PINR's recorder stand-in (scripts/decide-pinr.py, installed as manager/decide.py through profiles/pinr.json) takes a required --for line (one plain sentence, at least three words), writes it as 'For: ...' in the log entry and shows it back to read to the founder; a decision with no For: line is refused with a plain message saying what to add and nothing is written. Entries already in PINR's log are untouched. Reaches PINR by the usual install step, run by Manager_PINR.
